name: com.sirfus/car
title: Sirfus CAR
description: Get a confirmed answer from one checked local business for any request. Free for the person.

tools.name: car_find_business
tools.description: Reads a request and says which category and safety tier it falls in, and whether checked businesses that fit are signed up near the place. When the kind of business is unclear it returns needsDetail with a question and choices for the person. Contacts no one and returns no contact details. No sign-in needed.

where.description: City and two-letter US state, e.g. "Tampa, FL"

category.description: Optional. A category slug from /v1/categories that the person picked, for example after a needs_detail question. Without it, CAR reads the request.

tools.name: car_send_request
tools.description: Starts a request for the signed-in person. Needs what they need, where (City, ST), and their consent. Returns a requestId. If CAR is not sure what kind of business it needs, it answers needs_detail with a question and choices and sends nothing; a repeat call with category set to one of those choices goes ahead. Status verify_person means the person was texted a 6-digit code, which car_confirm_person checks. No business is contacted before that.

what.description: What the person needs, in their own words. This text goes to the matched business, so it holds no health details, ID numbers, card numbers or passwords.

where.description: City and two-letter US state, e.g. "Tampa, FL" (a ZIP may follow)

when.description: asap, this_week, flexible, or a date (YYYY-MM-DD)

size.description: Size of the job, e.g. "40 guests", "3 bedrooms"

budget.description: Budget, if the person gave one

name.description: First name the business can ask for

phone.description: US mobile number to text the confirmation code to. Defaults to the signed-in number.

consent.description: The person agreed to be contacted by one matched business and by CAR about this request

idempotencyKey.description: 8-64 letters, digits, _ or -. A repeat with the same key returns the same request

category.description: Optional. A category slug from /v1/categories that the person picked, for example after a needs_detail question. Without it, CAR reads the request.

estimateId.description: An estimateId from car_get_estimate: the business gets the same scope and planning range

tools.name: car_confirm_person
tools.description: Sends the 6-digit code the person received. When it is right, the request goes to one checked business. Five wrong codes close the request.

code.description: The 6-digit code the person received by text

tools.name: car_check_status
tools.description: Status of a request: verify_person, matching, offered, accepted, answered, still_looking, or a final state. Final states include the business that accepted, when there is one.

tools.name: car_cancel_request
tools.description: Cancels a request before it goes to a business (while it waits for the text code). After it has gone to a business it cannot be canceled here.

tools.name: car_estimate_services
tools.description: Lists the services the planning estimate covers (house cleaning, bathroom remodel, handyman, plumbing repair, HVAC) with each one's questions and option values, and which CAR categories map to them. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: car_get_estimate
tools.description: A price range for the job researched from local prices (with where the prices came from), not a quote. Contacts no one. Returns an estimateId; an estimateId passed with car_send_request gives the business the same scope and range. No sign-in needed.

service.description: house-cleaning, bathroom-remodel, handyman, plumbing-repair or hvac (car_estimate_services lists them with their questions)

where.description: "City, ST" when there is no ZIP

answers.description: Question id -> option value (a list for multi-choice questions)

tools.name: car_find_outside
tools.description: Only when no signed-up Sirfus business fits the work and place: up to 3 businesses from public listings, each with where it was found, its public phone and website, a rating only when Google gave one, and availability only when known ("we'll confirm a time" otherwise). CAR contacts none of them and shares nothing about the person. Legal work is not listed; health work is listed by distance, not ranked. Returns a searchId for car_pick_outside.

where.description: City and two-letter US state, e.g. "Tampa, FL"

category.description: Optional. A category slug from /v1/categories that the person picked, for example after a needs_detail question. Without it, CAR reads the request.

tools.name: car_pick_outside
tools.description: Records the business the person chose. CAR does not contact it or share the person's details; the person contacts it directly. Returns a request (status outside_picked) for status and webhooks.

optionId.description: The option the person picked: "1", "2" or "3"

tools.name: car_set_webhook
tools.description: Registers an https URL that receives a POST on every change of this agent's requests (status and loop stage), signed with the returned secret: CAR-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>. The secret is shown once. Up to 5 per agent.

url.description: https URL (port 443, a host name) that receives a signed POST on every change of your requests
